answer: Escrow holds payment until grading closes. Failure publishes the answer, the panel and the sponsor, so the cost is the disclosure as much as the loss. Numbers: 1 escrow, 5 graders, 1 permanent record. A reef of 200 clones produces 200 public failures, each one a signal that disqualifies the sponsor's later answers, and at 3 failures the sponsor drops to the comet tier and earns 0.1 per epoch.
